verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a self-serve merchant path: create a Seller Agent, click Create Service with pricing/identity requirements, and submit for approval, after which sellers can charge pay/kya-pay tokens via a documented API. There's also a dedicated 'sell to your customers' agents' flow and MCP Server Resource publishing for discoverability. Missing for 10: independent evidence of approval turnaround time/ease, and explicit documentation of a merchant agreement or ToS acceptance step (approval process is opaque).
